summary.text: Donna Campbell, M.D., a Republican and board certified emergency room physician from the New Braunfels area, represents Texas Senate District 25 and has served in the Senate since 2013. In 2012 she became the fifteenth woman ever elected to the Texas Senate.

paragraphs.text: Campbell was born on a naval base; her father served in the U.S. Navy and later as a highway patrol trooper.

She completed a Masters of Nursing at Texas Woman's University and received her M.D. from Texas Tech University, and completed her residency in ophthalmology at the University of Texas Health Science Center in Houston.
She has volunteered with Christian Eye Ministries and performed hundreds of eye surgeries in Ghana.

During the 88th Legislative Session she was appointed chair of the Senate Committee on Nominations and vice chair of the Senate Committee on Education, and she chaired Veteran Affairs from 2015 to 2021.
